research_question: Finite corrected choice fits as the correction weight tends to one, where the observed menus lose all curvature weight.
checks: Derive the zero-recession cone, the endpoint selection rule when the unit infimum is attained, and the logarithmic direction when the unit solution lies on a proper auxiliary face.
Compare the joint human and auxiliary gap rule with the two single-component rules in fixed exact constructions.
Use three continuation cases with known outcomes: rank one boundary, binary full rank boundary, grouped three-alternative boundary.
Include an attained rank-deficient unit limit and a design with no finite positive-weight path.
Retain all predetermined endpoint distances, full coefficients, score checks in the original criterion and held-out losses.
scope: Fixed finite designs. Examples are mathematical constructions. Existing released data supply a separate assessment of how many observed unit solutions are at zero support margin.
